title: RollCall #0 - Layer 2 protocol & EVM standardization call #0
summary: This is a call to discuss a frameworks to help aid with coordination between the various EVM-like L2s. The idea is to establish **optional** norms and standards for L2s to be able to extend the EVM and related tooling while limiting conflicts with the L1 EVM and preventing a proliferation of mutually incompatible standards among the L2s. ## Meeting Info - [Wed Oct 18, 2023, 14:00-15:30 UTC](https://savvytime.com/conv
